# Design tokens

The shared UI uses a three-layer token system: raw scales live in the Tailwind preset
(packages/ui/tailwind.preset.js), semantic colors and elevation live as CSS variables in
packages/ui/src/index.css, and components consume both through Tailwind utilities and cva
variants. This page is generated from those sources; pnpm check:tokens fails when this
page drifts from them.

## Colors

Semantic colors are HSL triplets consumed as hsl(var(--token)), so the .dark class swaps
values without touching utilities. State colors pair a base with a -foreground variant.
Light status labels use fresh pastel surfaces, clear colored text and fine tinted borders:
status-success uses green, status-warning amber, status-danger red and status-info blue.
Dark status labels keep muted, lower-saturation colors. Both themes use compact rounded
corners and readable text; neutral labels reuse secondary, secondary-foreground and border.
The status palettes remain independent of action and alert colors, so adjusting a status
label does not change destructive buttons or inline error notices.
Notifications follow the application theme (including system mode) and reuse these status
palettes; neutral notices use card colors. Chart fills and matching legend markers use
chart-1 through chart-6 over chart-track, with a lower-saturation dark palette.

## Radius

--radius is 8px and the preset derives the rest; larger elements round more.

| Key | Value | Resolved |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DEFAULT` | `4px` | `4px` |
| `lg` | `var(--radius)` | `8px` |
| `md` | `calc(var(--radius) - 2px)` | `6px` |
| `sm` | `calc(var(--radius) - 4px)` | `4px` |
| `xl` | `12px` | `12px` |
| `2xl` | `16px` | `16px` |
| `3xl` | `24px` | `24px` |

## Elevation

Elevation carries structure instead of decorative borders: wells (e0), resting surfaces
(e1-e2), hover lift (e3) and floating layers (e4). Each utility maps to a full box-shadow
list that flips with the theme.

| Utility | Light | Dark | Role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shadow-e0` | `inset 0 1px 2px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.07), 0 0 0 1px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.05)` | `inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)` | Wells: inputs, progress tracks, checkbox fields |
| `shadow-e1` | `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65), 0 1px 2px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.04), 0 0 0 1px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.06)` | `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07)` | Resting surfaces: cards, sidebar, panels |
| `shadow-e2` | `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65), 0 1px 3px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.06), 0 0 0 1px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.07)` | `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)` | Interactive controls at rest |
| `shadow-e3` | `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65), 0 4px 8px -2px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.08), 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.14), 0 0 0 1px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.06)` | `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06), 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09)` | Hover lift state |
| `shadow-e4` | `0 8px 16px -4px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.08), 0 28px 56px -20px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.22), 0 0 0 1px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.06)` | `0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.09)` | Floating layers: dialogs, popovers, toasts |
| `shadow-focus-ring` | `0 0 0 1px hsl(var(--ring))` | `0 0 0 1px hsl(var(--ring))` | Keyboard focus halo, composed with an elevation |
| `shadow-input-hover` | `inset 0 1px 2px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.09), 0 0 0 1px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.16)` | `inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16)` |  |
| `shadow-sidebar` | `0 0 0 1px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.05), 12px 0 32px -20px rgba(24, 26, 32, 0.18)` | `0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06), 12px 0 32px -20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)` | Sidebar right edge: hairline plus soft shadow |

## Motion

Compose durations and easings, for example duration-motion-normal ease-decelerate for an
entrance. Exits accelerate, hover and press feedback stay standard, and the sidebar keeps
its dedicated rhythm.

| Utility | Value | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `duration-motion-fast` | `120ms` | Presses, color and focus changes |
| `duration-motion-normal` | `200ms` | Standard transitions and entrances |
| `duration-motion-slow` | `320ms` | Large surfaces: dialogs, page transitions |
| `duration-sidebar` | `280ms` | Sidebar collapse (kept legacy rhythm) |

| Utility | Curve | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ease-standard` | `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)` | General feedback |
| `ease-decelerate` | `cubic-bezier(0.05, 0.7, 0.1, 1)` | Enter: fast start, soft landing |
| `ease-accelerate` | `cubic-bezier(0.3, 0, 0.8, 0.15)` | Exit: soft start, quick finish |
| `ease-sidebar` | `cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)` | Sidebar collapse curve |

## Usage conventions

- Pixel-only: spacing, typography and geometry speak px; never em or rem.
- Components use semantic utilities such as bg-status-success and text-warning-text;
  raw Tailwind palette classes are a guardrail violation.
- Combine elevation with the focus halo through an arbitrary value listing the variables,
  for example shadow-[var(--shadow-e2),var(--shadow-focus-ring)].
- Never use transition-all; transition only transform, opacity, box-shadow, background-color
  or color, and never change layout properties on hover, focus or active states.
- Dark mode is class-based: tokens flip automatically, so components never hardcode dark
  palette colors.
- To change a token, edit packages/ui/src/index.css or packages/ui/tailwind.preset.js, run
  pnpm gen:tokens and commit the regenerated pages; CI enforces pnpm check:tokens.
